title: security: RBAC v2 - enforce KMS region pinning + residency audit logging hardening
author: Anya Rodriguez
description: This PR hardens RBAC v2 policy enforcement for KMS region pinning and improves audit logging for data residency decisions. Motivation: customers in regulated industries need guarantees that KMS keys and model outputs are restricted to allowed regions and that all policy decisions are recorded for compliance reviews. Changes include: 1) a new policy validator that rejects resource creations which reference KMS keys outside the allowed residency regions for the workspace; 2) an admission-time residency check that enforces region pinning on model artifacts, KMS keys, and storage buckets; 3) enhanced audit-log entries that include policy decision metadata (policy id, matched rules, operator, and residency rationale) and consistently record the effective region for all user-facing operations; 4) migration helpers and a toggle for staged rollout (rbac.v2.residency_hardening.enabled) to avoid customer disruption; 5) unit + integration tests and an e2e test against a mocked KMS service to validate enforcement and auditing. Checklist: - [x] Policy validator implementation - [x] Admission hook + enforcement - [x] Audit logging format update + serializer - [x] Migration tool + rollback path - [x] Tests (unit/integration/e2e) - [x] Documentation updates in docs/security and redwood-private-installer notes Rollout plan: start behind feature flag, enable for small cohort of enterprise customers with Legal/Compliance signoff, then ramp to all workspaces after monitoring. Follow-ups: add a metrics dashboard for residency rejections (ENG-1241), add telemetry to surface KMS mismatches in the Console (ENG-1302), and coordinate with the Private installer team for on-prem KMS config docs (PM-212).

review_comments: Michael Chen: We've got a good surface area here. Two requests: 1) make the audit log schema versioned so future changes are backward compatible; 2) ensure the admission hook returns a clear remediation message for Console UX.
Author (Anya Rodriguez): addressed - added schema_version field to serializer and standardized the remediation message to include error_code + suggested action.

Leah Brooks: Tests look good. One nit: the e2e mock KMS responses should include an HTTP 429 scenario to validate retry behavior.
Author: added 429 scenario in e2e; CI shows stable retries now.
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 and harden residency audit logging. This change adds a policy validator, admission-time enforcement, migration tooling, and enhanced audit log entries. Initially gated behind a feature flag; admins should read docs/security/residency-hardening.md for rollout guidance.
notes_for_ops: Feature is gated by rbac.v2.residency_hardening.enabled. Use the migration CLI to annotate or remediate non-compliant resources before enabling globally. Monitor residency.rejection_count and audit.log_errors during rollout.
security_impact: High: affects KMS usage and cross-region resource creation. Designed to reduce compliance risk by preventing region-mismatched KMS bindings. Ensure Legal/Compliance are informed before enabling for enterprise tenants.
testing_summary: Unit tests for validator, integration tests for admission hook, e2e tests using mocked KMS including 403/429 scenarios. CI run green after addressing retry behavior for transient KMS throttling.
migration_instructions: Run cmd/migrations/residency_migrate --dry-run to get a report. For non-compliant resources, use --annotate to tag and optionally --fix to auto-rebind to a compliant key when available. Rollback: set rbac.v2.residency_hardening.enabled=false and run migration CLI to clear annotations.
